about.who: I'm Ahmed Abu Qahf (som3aware), a full-stack engineer in Tanta, Egypt, working remotely. I work in the space between design and engineering: interfaces, the design systems behind them, and the products around them, on web and mobile.

journey.text: My fascination with computers started on visits to the countryside, rushing to use my cousin's computer, the first in our family, to explore apps and the early internet.
Ranked top of my whole governorate and got my first laptop as the prize.
Moved from using computers to managing them, installing operating systems, and wrote my first code in Visual Basic .NET: calculators and tools for the area and circumference of shapes.

Won 2nd place nationwide in JICA's first essay competition in Egypt, run with the Ministry of Education and sponsored by Toshiba El Araby, writing about my dreams for the future. Out of about 1,000 essays.

Studied computer engineering at AUC on a scholarship. Designed flyers and posters for student clubs (SPE, the Society of Petroleum Engineers; Glow; CSTA, the Community of Scientific and Technological Activities) and for yoga instructor sessions: my first design work.
Intern on Vodafone's meeting-room booking app: designed most of the screens and built the back end.
Hackathons: Hajj Hackathon in Jeddah (Kun 3awnan, IoT help for pilgrims) and Dell EMC 423x.

First full-time job at VOIS. Within months, sole maintainer of a COVID-19 mobility platform for governments, working with a UK supervisor. Helped rescue a late HR system and built a React Native component library from Vodafone's brand guidelines.

New Smart Egypt: software for government, enterprise and public places. An agricultural delivery-tracking app, the Ramses Station free Wi-Fi journey (designed and built), fingerprint-scanner integrations with Odoo. Deployed on cloud and on-premise.
MSE in Software Engineering at ASU, online, while working full time. 4.0 GPA, including a master's class on mobile systems with React Native.
Nodogoro: moved into AI products. Led Outlined AI and built LLM tools.
Eignspaces: client product work. Reconciled (acquired by LaborEdge), Hivo and Stayro.
Cypienta: a company-wide design system and an interface revamp for a security data platform.

principles.title: Honest and straightforward
principles.text: I value people who are genuine and say what they mean, and I try to be one: no spin, no detours, just what I did and what I didn't.
principles.proof: Every number on this site has a source, and shared work says so.

principles.title: Open mind, patient ear
principles.text: I try to hear the whole story before forming a view, and to stay patient while I do.
principles.proof: Tracing a months-old map bug at VOIS to its real cause, a platform setting, instead of the obvious suspect.

principles.title: Keep it simple
principles.text: I like taking complex things and making them simple, at work and at home. If it can be easier to use, I'll make it easier.
principles.proof: A Wi-Fi portal cut to a few clear steps; one view for invoice matching at Reconciled.

principles.title: Small details, big impact
principles.text: I notice the small stuff, the spacing, the empty state, the button that feels off, because that's what people feel.
principles.proof: This site's themes and keyboard states; screens refined with designers on Hivo and Stayro.

principles.title: Creative, but realistic
principles.text: I like creative ideas that can actually ship. Not everything fits the budget, the timeline or the team, so I look for the version that does.
principles.proof: Shipping Stayro's guest and host apps in two to three months; at Reconciled, “balance creativity with practical execution” (Brock Rumer).

principles.title: Keep learning
principles.text: I'm always eager to learn and grow, to be a better version of myself than I was yesterday.
principles.proof: An MSE at ASU while working full time; moving from web to mobile, AI and now design systems.

principles.title: Help people grow
principles.text: Helping someone get unstuck is my favourite part of the job. I mentor junior engineers and interns, and show teams how to use AI well.
principles.proof: Mentored interns and juniors on Hivo and Reconciled; led and reviewed a team of two; guided a junior through the Nafath integration.

principles.title: Share what I know
principles.text: I share what I learn through writing and through good discussions, about tech, history or football, in person or on a call.
principles.proof: Writing on Hashnode; training teams on AI-assisted workflows.

testimonials.name: Josh Zack
testimonials.title: President
testimonials.excerpt: He ramped fast, worked hard, and cared about the outcome, not just completing tickets. He helped us prove our idea was technically feasible, and was a pleasure to work with.
testimonials.full: Ahmed (Somaa) was an important piece for us in the founding story of Reconciled. He ramped fast, worked hard, and cared about the outcome, not just completing tickets. He helped us prove our idea was technically feasible, and was a pleasure to work with. What stood out day to day... he’s engaged, asks smart questions, pushes for clarity, and keeps communication tight. He's reliable, positive, and easy to work with. I’m genuinely grateful I got to work with him and I wish him many successes in the future.

testimonials.name: Brock Rumer
testimonials.title: Product & Design
testimonials.excerpt: He brought a thoughtful, detail-oriented approach to every discussion and consistently contributed ideas that helped us refine and improve the product.
testimonials.full: I had the pleasure of working with Ahmed during his contract with Reconciled, and I really valued the collaboration. He brought a thoughtful, detail-oriented approach to every discussion and consistently contributed ideas that helped us refine and improve the product. His ability to balance creativity with practical execution made a real difference, and his contributions had a tangible impact on our product’s evolution. I’d happily recommend Ahmed to any team looking for someone who can combine attention to detail, collaborative energy, and genuine commitment to building quality solutions.
